svg.title: Circle on a circle
svg.desc: Frequency modulation as wheels. A carrier's circle, and the sideband wheels that ride one another, each turning at its own whole multiple of the modulator's rate; where the last one ends is always on the carrier's circle, swung back and forth by the modulator. Beside it the sidebands as bars, at the carrier plus or minus whole multiples of the modulator, at a ratio of 3.5 to 1 as in the rayon glass bell; each bar is as tall as its wheel is big, and the bright knob's sweep makes them breathe.
